origin.origins_backgrounds_two.greenwitc: He kālena kūlohelohe ko Greenwitches no ka hoʻoulu ʻana i nā mea.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.hunter.de: Ua hoʻomaʻamaʻa ʻia ka poʻe Hunter me ke akamai o ke kakaka.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.swashbuck: Ua aʻo lākou i nā hana he nui o ka derring do.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.trader.de: ʻIke nā mea kālepa i ko lākou ala e hoʻololi ai i nā waiwai.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.deep_mine: ʻOi aku ka hohonu o lākou, ʻoi aku ka ikaika o nā lāʻau no ka ʻeli ʻana.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.miner.des: ʻO ka hana ma lalo o kahi Master Miner ua aʻo iā lākou i kaʻu wikiwiki a waiho ʻia paha i ka lepo pōhaku.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.blacksmit: ʻOi aku ka nui o ka loaʻa ʻana o ke kapa kila ma mua o ka ʻike.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.disenchan: Hoʻopili ka Disenchanters' Guild i ka wehe ʻana i nā mana makemake ʻole.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.name: Kuke's Apprentice
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.cook.desc: ʻAʻole paha lākou ʻo ke Poʻo Chef, akā ʻaʻole lākou e ʻona iā ʻoe.Pohō.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.sentry.de: Hiki ke lohi iki, akā hiki iā lākou ke hoʻomau i ka hele lōʻihi.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.bounty_hu: Inā makemake ʻoe i ka hōʻoia o ka make, e hāʻawi lākou.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.pickpocke: Pono paha ʻoe e hoʻopaʻa i kāu mau waiwai me lākou a puni.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.acrobat.d: He mea ʻole nā pā i kahi Acrobat
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.butcher.d: Ua ʻike lākou i ka ʻoki ʻana me ka ʻole o ka pau ʻole o ka ʻiʻo.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.alchemist: Hoʻolaha ka mana i ka wā e inu ai i nā lāʻau.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.street_ra: ʻO ka ulu ʻana ma ke alanui, ua aʻo lākou i ke kila i ko lākou ʻōpū.
Ua lilo ka wili ʻana i ke koʻi liʻiliʻi i mea ʻelua no nā Woodsmen.
origin.origins_backgrounds_two.angler.de: Mai ka moku a i ʻole mai ke kahakai, loaʻa mau i ka Angler ka iʻa maikaʻi loa.
